title: A project from relay setup is dirty after its first check
what: relay setup adds .ci/ and the worktrees folder from kit.toml (and the stack's caches) to .gitignore, keeping lines that exist.
why: relay setup writes no .gitignore: .ci/, .worktrees/, __pycache__ and .pytest_cache show as untracked, so the primary checkout, which the rules say must stay clean, is dirty after bin/wt new and after the first check.
failing_case: Trial: after bin/wt new add-count-unique-words, git status on master showed '?? .worktrees/'; after bin/check it showed .ci/, __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/.
pass_cases: Fresh setup, one check, one bin/wt new: git status --short on the default branch is empty; an existing .gitignore keeps its lines.
